name: 3-TSB
summary: 3-Thiosymbescaline (3-TSB), also known as 3-ethylthio-4-methoxy-5-ethoxyphenethylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of symbescaline in which the ethoxy group at the 3 position has been replaced with an ethylthio group. The compound is one of two possible thiosymbescaline (TSB) positional isomers, the other being 4-thiosymbescaline (4-TSB).
